CODE DERIVATION: SINGLE spec s2c_desirecert.csv = (s2c, [(desireforcert1 -> desireforcert1, rev 0), (desireforcert -> desireforcert2, rev 0)]): the first code IS the source column name; the second is an explicit named rename of the unnumbered source column 'desireforcert' (.sav column 53, 0-based 52, immediately after desireforcert1) -- a dict entry, not positional assignment. No '-' flip prefix, so resp is the deposited value and the live table has no itemcov_recoded column; the docstring's pooled 8 - resp rewrite does not apply to this single-study table. Exempt from Step 5b (source-name / explicit named rename), no verification files; the rename is independently confirmed by the per-item count vectors below, which differ between the two items and match the live table cell for cell. TEXT: variable labels shipped verbatim, except that desireforcert1's label opens with the Qualtrics matrix lead-in 'To what extent do you agree with the following statements:' followed by a line break; that lead-in is shipped once in instructions (it heads the two-statement block) and removed from item_text. desireforcert's label carries no lead-in. OPTIONS: all seven points value-labelled identically on both items: 1 Strongly agree, 2 Agree, 3 Somewhat agree, 4 Neither agree nor disagree, 5 Somewhat disagree, 6 Disagree, 7 Strongly disagree; shipped verbatim. DIRECTION: 1 = Strongly agree, so high resp = less desire for certainty. Corroborated: item means 2.71 / 2.68 (agree side); r = +0.30/+0.31 with COVIDcert1 (same 1 = Strongly agree anchoring, uncertainty statement) and -0.13 to -0.23 with selfcert1-2 (1 = very much ... 7 = not at all), i.e. people who feel certain about themselves want certainty less -- consistent only with the labelled direction. Inter-item r = 0.795. Script docstring lists _s2c_desirecert among the 1 = Strongly agree tables. COUNTS: source 793 rows, 793 non-missing per item; live 1586 rows = 793 ids x 2; per-item resp-count vectors (1..7) source = live exactly: desireforcert1 133/259/237/89/34/30/11, desireforcert2 (source desireforcert) 149/258/218/93/30/34/11. Rights: items carry no source-instrument attribution in the deposit and appear study-authored; no fee, permission, NC or redistribution clause located (silence = permission); no register row applies, none written.
